sn38.5:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso sāriputta assāsappatto hotīti.
sn38.5:1.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ettāvatā kho āvuso assāsappatto hotīti.
sn38.5:1.4: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.5:1.5: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.5:1.6: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.5:1.7: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāya. seyyathidaṃ:
sn38.5:1.9: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.5:1.10: bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāya.
